sources.native_capex_anchor_comparator: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rser.2022.112781 (Table 3, Li-ion battery CAPEX in M EUR/MWh; the four 2020/2030/2040/2050 values match the workbook after rounding; the price base year is not established here.)

assumptions.existing_scope: Documented commercial installations. Vis enters by the 2025 anchor. Both Sibenik phases enter by 2030 and total 60 MW, 120 MWh.
assumptions.energy_basis: Reported MWh are taken as usable internal SOC limits in the absence of a DC-to-AC metering boundary for both assets. New two-hour duration refers to grid-delivered discharge.
assumptions.new_grid_discharge_duration_h: Two-hour scenario based on the documented Sibenik project. The project's nameplate ratio is an analogy for the scenario, not a fleet measurement.
assumptions.one_way_efficiency: Retain 0.90 from the active H2RES input, giving 0.81 round trip.
assumptions.commercial_stock_replacement: Future investments may replace retired capacity within the existing model's build limits. Legacy battery CAPEX and annual build limits are not revised by this policy.
